review: Full English automatic subtitles read (00:00-07:28.751), plus 48 visually reviewed sampled frames across the video. Auto captions can misrecognize names. Not an audit of trades.
source_files: Archived separately in the local source review; no private paths in this package.

principles.idea: Put interesting narrative/volume candidates on a watchlist before chasing the initial pump.
Research a roughly 70% pullback only while the underlying narrative remains relevant.
Plan profit taking; examples of partial sales do not justify rewriting the existing TP50 experiment.
Separate realized profit from a hypothetical missed later peak; limit attention overload.

operationalization: Measure decline from the observed pre-decision same-pool peak, not an unobserved ATH. Require enough contiguous observations, fresh retrieval, positive liquidity, an up-to-date full risk scan and timestamped manual narrative evidence. Exact reported-creator match holds research for review. Output never authorizes an order.
not_inferred: The claimed $600k is not independently verified.
A selloff is not necessarily panic; it may be liquidity removal, insider selling, changed facts or a data error.
Market-cap chart moves are not executable returns.
A social link is not evidence that a narrative is intact.
Shared exchange funder or synchronized trades do not establish common ownership.
validation_plan: Freeze this revision before new candidates. Log all watchlisted and rejected candidates, evidence as known at decision time and source timestamps. Compare later same-pool outcomes in time-ordered holdout, including losses, missing data, costs and liquidity. No post-entry evidence as entry prediction; no historical trial statistics changed.
